generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.-NOT APPLICABLE

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are NOT acceptable

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The Intending bidder are advised to visit the site of work and access the tender documents well in advance.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The tender processing fee will not be refunded
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.

The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Through ONLINE only With validity from the date of opening of the tender. The tender schedule will be issued to the applicants who make payment through ONLINE only. Tenders received without valid EMD through e- payment will be rejected. Under this section of qualifying criteria the tenderer should furnish capacity details / format.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in e-portal within 3 days of opening of technical Bid

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, KRS Division, Krishnarajasagara, during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events
Defect liability period is THREE YEARS from the date of completion of the entire work, after issuing of work completion certificate from CNNL.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.
The tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The application made by the firm / company shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney shall be submitted

Necessary certificates should be signed by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent competent authority and should be countersigned by the superior officer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer or equivalent competent authority.

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or on going under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the last five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicants financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers.
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before attending the pre- bid meeting and also before submitting the tenders.

Royalty Charges shall be recovered as per the prevailing rates by the Department of Mines and Geology & The Intending bidder should strictly follow the Department of Mines & Geology circular no. 11189-1121 Dated:26.02.2024.

The rates quoted by the contractor must be inclusive of all Taxes, etc., (including GST). The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor.
GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time in running bill
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Materials like steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL/ Karnataka Research station, if not by any NABL accredited labs before use in this work.

The work includes all lead and lift / delift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per relevant Indian standard codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the expiry of the defect liability period.

Building and other construction workers welfare cess The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill.This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate.
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.
Sub leasing /subcontracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Subleasing/subcontracting are liable for rejection.

The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard.

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand, as an alternative the use of manufactured sand (M-sand)confirming to relevant IS specifications may be allowed during the remodeling work

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge. All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue. The rates for the specification in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts.
The contractor should have capacity of deploying centralized batching plant along with The transit mixture during execution of concrete works for both structures and lining.
Successful Bidder should submit the PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement.
Successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of acceptance, failing which his tender will be cancelled as per terminiation clause in Bid document
Related to qualification condition No :2, Idle charges for men & machineries for non- progress period delayed due to any reasons will not be paid.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted.
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor.
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender.
Conditions as per bid document.
